overview: The Medford High School Building Committee met to approve minutes and invoices, and to vote on space programming and design recommendations for the dining facilities, the Curtis Tufts High School Program, and the Medford Early Education Program.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The committee approved the minutes of the August 25, 2026 meeting with an amendment to incorporate discussion details regarding parking spaces.

items.title: Approval of Invoices and Budget Update
items.summary: The committee reviewed the feasibility study budget and approved two invoices for August services from Left Field and SMMA totaling $115,000.

items.title: Dining and Food Service Programming
items.summary: The committee approved the dining and food service design recommendations, which feature a quiet dining area, a scramble servery, and dedicated dishwashing space.

items.title: Curtis Tufts High School Program Review
items.summary: The committee approved Curtis Tufts program space recommendations to remove the games room and breakout rooms, while directing that classroom sizes be explored further.

items.title: Medford Early Education Program (MEEP) Programming
items.summary: A motion to eliminate all MEEP spaces from the project was denied, after which the committee approved recommendations to eliminate the playroom and breakout rooms, reduce observation spaces, and downsize the laundry room.

items.title: Upcoming Design Process and Community Forum
items.summary: The committee reviewed the forthcoming design and site safety review schedule, and discussed the virtual community forum on sustainability scheduled for September 17.
